description: Opt-in Gmsh Python import, bounded surface meshing, and expected rejection.

foundation.scope: Fixed public 2D square only; foundation evidence does not certify the broker or MATH3D path.

rejection.expectedReason: Only the registered fixed square GEO fixture is accepted

arguments:
import gmsh
gmsh.initialize()
try:
 gmsh.option.setNumber('General.Terminal', 0)
 gmsh.model.add('bounded-square')
 gmsh.model.occ.addRectangle(0, 0, 0, 1, 1)
 gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()
 gmsh.model.mesh.generate(2)
 types, elements, nodes = gmsh.model.mesh.getElements(2)
 count = sum(len(tags) for tags in elements)
 assert count > 0, 'no surface elements'
 print('surface elements:', count)
finally:
 gmsh.finalize()
